references.text: The prophecy that Israel (figured as a fruitful tree) would be made fruitless due to their disobedience and lack of faith mirrors Jesus' cursing of the fig tree as a demonstration of God's judgment on spiritual barrenness.
Micah predicts the destruction of the high places, an act of judgment, which parallels Jesus' action with the fig tree to show judgment over superficial piety.
A parallel event where Jesus cursed another fig tree for not bearing fruit, which also serves as a lesson on faith and prayer.
